input.description: string `Tensor`, the source strings to process.

pattern.description: string or scalar string `Tensor`, regular expression to use, see more details at https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax

rewrite.description: string or scalar string `Tensor`, value to use in match replacement, supports backslash-escaped digits (\1 to \9) which can be to insert text matching corresponding parenthesized group.

replace_global.description: `bool`, if `True` replace all non-overlapping matches, else replace only the first match.
constraints: If replace_global is not provided, it defaults to True.

output.description: string `Tensor` of the same shape as `input` with specified replacements.
